facts.statement: Zuul lived during the Campanian stage of the Late Cretaceous.
facts.quote: fossil_range: Campanian~

facts.statement: The skeleton of Zuul was discovered on May 16 when a loader hit an ankylosaur tail club while removing a 12-meter-high layer of earth.
facts.quote: On 16 May, a skid-steer loader removing a 12 m-high overburden unexpectedly hit upon an ankylosaurian tail club.

facts.statement: Zuul was found in the Judith River Formation, specifically the middle Coal Ridge Member, dating between 76.2 and 75.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: The specimen, which is stored as ROM 75860, was found in a sandstone layer of the Judith River Formation, part of the middle Coal Ridge Member with an age of between 76.2 and 75.2 million years.

facts.statement: The genus name Zuul honors the demon from the 1984 film Ghostbusters because the dinosaur's head resembles that character.
facts.quote: The generic name was adopted from the demon and demi-god Zuul, the Gatekeeper of Gozer, featured in the 1984 film Ghostbusters.

facts.statement: The species name crurivastator means "Destroyer of Shins," referring to the animal's presumed tactic of smashing predators' legs with its tail club.
facts.quote: The specific name is derived from Latin crus, "shank", and vastator, "destroyer".

facts.statement: Zuul crurivastator was formally named and described by Arbour and Evans in 2017.
facts.quote: In 2017, based on the specimen the type species Zuul crurivastator was named and described by Arbour and Evans.

facts.statement: Zuul is the first ankylosaurine dinosaur known from both a complete skull and a complete tail club.
facts.quote: It is known from a complete skull and tail, which represents the first ankylosaurin known from a complete skull and tail club

facts.statement: As of 2017, the Zuul specimen was the most complete ankylosaur found in the Judith River Formation.
facts.quote: The specimen is, as of 2017, the most complete ankylosaur find from the Judith River Formation.

facts.statement: Zuul was estimated to be 6 meters long.
facts.quote: Zuul is estimated to have been 6 m long.

facts.statement: The armor tiles on Zuul's head were overlapping and pointed at the top.
facts.quote: The caputegulae, armour tiles of the head, that lay on the nasal bones, the frontals and the parietals, are imbricated, overlapping, and pointed on top.

facts.statement: The horns on the back corners of Zuul's skull roof feature prominent longitudinal grooves on their sides.
facts.quote: The squamosal horns, on the rear corners of the skull roof, have conspicuous longitudinal grooves on their side surfaces.

facts.statement: Zuul's skull was about 50 cm long, making it the second largest among ankylosaurs in western North America after Ankylosaurus.
facts.quote: With a length of about 50 cm, the skull of Zuul is of considerable size, being only surpassed among the ankylosaurs of Laramidia (western North America) by the three known skulls of Ankylosaurus

facts.statement: Zuul had a wide snout that was flat and cut off at the front.
facts.quote: The snout is wide and truncated at the front.

facts.statement: Zuul's teeth were small, leaf-shaped, and flattened from side to side.
facts.quote: The teeth are small, leaf-shaped and transversely flattened.

facts.statement: Researchers suggest that Zuul used its tail club to smash the lower legs of attacking predators as a defensive tactic.
facts.quote: The epithet, read as "Destroyer of Shins" by the naming authors, refers to a presumed defensive tactic of ankylosaurids, smashing the lower legs of attacking predatory theropods with their tail clubs.

facts.statement: Bony plates located deep in Zuul's eye sockets have been interpreted by some researchers as bony eyelids.
facts.quote: Deep in each eye socket, a bony plate is present. Similar plates in specimens of Euoplocephalus and Dyoplosaurus were reported by Walter Preston Coombs as bony eyelids.

facts.statement: The combined length of Zuul's tooth rows was approximately 16 cm.
facts.quote: The tooth row has a length of about 16 cm.

facts.statement: Each of Zuul's teeth had between twelve and fourteen cusps along their edges.
facts.quote: The teeth have in total twelve to fourteen cusps on their edges.

facts.statement: Zuul is classified as an extinct herbivorous ankylosaurine dinosaur.
facts.quote: Zuul is an extinct genus of herbivorous ankylosaurine dinosaur from the Campanian Judith River Formation of Montana.

facts.statement: Zuul's tail club knob was vertically flattened with a height less than one-fifth of its total length.
facts.quote: The tail knob is vertically flattened with a height less than a fifth of the length.

facts.statement: The tail of Zuul measures a total length of 278 centimeters.
facts.quote: The tail has a total length of 278 cm.

facts.statement: The tail club of Zuul, including the handle, is 210 cm long, which is a record length for North American ankylosaurids.
facts.quote: The tail club, including the handle, has a length of 210 cm, a record among North American ankylosaurids.

facts.statement: The handle of Zuul's tail contains thirteen vertebrae, with a probable additional three covered by the knob.
facts.quote: In the handle, thirteen vertebrae are present. Probably another three are covered by the knob.

facts.statement: Ossified tendons stiffening Zuul's tail handle are over 50 cm long and range from 5 to 8 mm in diameter.
facts.quote: The tendons are over 50 cm long and 5 - 8 mm in diameter, with tapering ends.

facts.statement: Five pairs of osteoderms run along the sides of the handle of Zuul's tail.
facts.quote: Along the sides of the handle runs a series of five pairs of osteoderms.

facts.statement: The tail knob of Zuul measures 52.5 cm in length, 36.8 cm in width, and 8 cm in vertical height.
facts.quote: The knob is relatively large with a length of 52.5 cm, a width of 36.8 cm, and a vertical height of 8 cm.

facts.statement: Fossilized keratin skin scales preserved on Zuul's tail are exceedingly rare finds.
facts.quote: Such fossil scale remains are exceedingly rare.

facts.statement: The preserved fossil scales on Zuul's tail have a diameter between 5 and 6.5 centimeters.
facts.quote: The scales are relatively large with a diameter of between 5 - 6.5 cm.

facts.statement: Zuul is estimated to have reached a length of six meters and weighed 2.5 tons.
facts.quote: Se estima que Zuul habría medido unos seis metros de longitud y habría pesado 2.5 toneladas.

facts.statement: The squamosal horns on the back corners of Zuul's skull vault have conspicuous grooves on their lateral surfaces.
facts.quote: Los cuernos escamosales, en las esquinas posteriores de la bóveda craneana, tienen unos surcos conspicuos en sus superficies laterales.

facts.statement: The caputegulae on the prefrontals, frontoparietals, and mid supraorbitals of Zuul are pyramidal in shape, contrasting with the conical caputegulae of Nodocephalosaurus and Talarurus.
facts.quote: Las caputegulae en los prefrontales, los frontoparietales y los supraorbitales medios tienen forma piramidal, en contraste con las caputegulae cónicas de Nodocephalosaurus y Talarurus.

facts.statement: The osteoderms on the tail club handle of Zuul are relatively larger and sharper than those of ankylosaurines from the Nemegt Formation in Mongolia.
facts.quote: Los osteodermos en el tallo de la maza caudal son relativamente más grandes y más agudos que los de los anquilosaurinos procedentes de la Formación Nemegt en Mongolia.

facts.statement: By 2017, only the tail of the Zuul skeleton had been prepared for study.
facts.quote: Of the remainder of the skeleton only the tail had been prepared in 2017.

facts.statement: Arbour and Evans described Zuul in 2017 based on a phylogenetic analysis placing it within the Ankylosauridae.
facts.quote: In 2017, Arbour and Evans placed Zuul within the Ankylosauridae, based on a phylogenetic analysis.

facts.statement: The genus Zuul was named by Arbour and Evans in 2017.
facts.quote: genus_authority: Arbour & Evans, 2017

facts.statement: The species Zuul crurivastator was named by Arbour and Evans in 2017.
facts.quote: species_authority: Arbour & Evans, 2017

facts.statement: Zuul lived during the Campanian stage of the Late Cretaceous, approximately 75 million years ago, in what is now North America.
facts.quote: que vivó a finales del período Cretácico hace 75 millones de años durante el Campaniense, en lo que es hoy Norteamérica

facts.statement: Zuul is classified as an ankylosaurine ankylosaurid that forms a clade with Ankylosaurus, Anodontosaurus, Dyoplosaurus, and Scolosaurus.
facts.quote: More specifically, they identified it as an ankylosaurin ankylosaurine ankylosaurid, forming a clade with Ankylosaurus, Anodontosaurus, Dyoplosaurus and Scolosaurus.

facts.statement: The phylogenetic analysis of Zuul yielded inconclusive results regarding the exact interrelationships of ankylosaurins, largely influenced by the placement of Anodontosaurus and Ziapelta.
facts.quote: Although the consensus of the phylogenetic trees recovered by the analysis was inconclusive regarding the interrelationships of ankylosaurins, this was influenced mainly by the relative placements of Anodontosaurus and Ziapelta within the tree.

facts.statement: Phylogenetic trees recovered for Zuul show nine out of ten place it as the sister group of Dyoplosaurus, while one tree places it closer to Anodontosaurus.
facts.quote: Out of the ten most parsimonious trees they recovered, nine of them have Zuul as the sister group of Dyoplosaurus, while in the remaining tree Zuul is closer to Anodontosaurus.

facts.statement: The skull of Zuul is approximately 50 centimeters long.
facts.quote: Con una longitud de unos 50 centímetros, el cráneo de Zuul es de un tamaño considerable

facts.statement: Zuul had a wide, blunt snout at the front of its skull.
facts.quote: El hocico es ancho y truncado en la parte delantera

facts.statement: Each nasal cavity in Zuul's skull contained only a single nasal opening.
facts.quote: En cada fosa nasal solo se ve una única abertura nasal

facts.statement: Zuul possessed robust, pyramid-shaped squamosal horns at the rear corners of the skull roof.
facts.quote: Los cuernos escamosos en las esquinas traseras del techo del cráneo son robustos y de forma piramidal

facts.statement: The row of teeth in Zuul's jaw was approximately 16 centimeters long.
facts.quote: La hilera de dientes tiene una longitud de unos 16 centímetros

facts.statement: Zuul's teeth were small, leaf-shaped, and flattened sideways.
facts.quote: Los dientes son pequeños, en forma de hoja y aplanados transversalmente

facts.statement: The crown height of Zuul's front teeth was approximately 7 millimeters.
facts.quote: La altura de su corona es de unos 7 milímetros

facts.statement: Zuul's teeth had between twelve and fourteen cusps along their edges.
facts.quote: Los dientes tienen en total de doce a catorce cúspides en sus bordes

facts.statement: The total length of Zuul's tail is 278 centimeters.
facts.quote: La cola tiene una longitud total de 278 centímetros

facts.statement: Zuul holds the record for the longest tail club shaft among North American ankylosaurids, measuring 210 centimeters including the handle.
facts.quote: El garrote de la cola, incluido el mango, tiene una longitud de 210 centímetros, un récord entre los anquilosáuridos de América del Norte

facts.statement: The handle of Zuul's tail club was a rigid structure due to special connections between vertebrae that prevented flexibility.
facts.quote: El mango es una estructura rígida, la falta de flexibilidad causada por conexiones especiales entre las vértebras

facts.statement: The ossified tendons stiffening Zuul's tail club handle were over 50 centimeters long.
facts.quote: Los tendones miden más de 50 centímetros (20 pulgadas) de largo

facts.statement: Zuul is the first North American ankylosaurid in which osteoderms on the tail club handle have been discovered.
facts.quote: Zuul es el primer anquilosáurido americano en el que se han descubierto tales osteodermos del mango

facts.statement: Zuul's tail club head (flange) is large, measuring 52.5 cm long, 36.8 cm wide, and 8 cm high.
facts.quote: La perilla es relativamente grande con una longitud de 52,5 centímetros , un ancho de 36,8 centímetros y una altura vertical de 8 centímetros

facts.statement: Non-bony scales preserved on Zuul's tail were relatively large, with diameters between 5 and 6.5 centimeters.
facts.quote: Las escamas son relativamente grandes con un diámetro de entre 5 y 6,5 centímetros

facts.statement: Fossil remains of keratinous scales like those found on Zuul are extremely rare.
facts.quote: Tales restos de escamas fósiles son extremadamente raros

facts.statement: The upper jaw of Zuul contained between eighteen and twenty teeth.
facts.quote: Las filas de dientes de las mandíbulas superiores tienen entre dieciocho y veinte dientes

facts.statement: The lower jaw of Zuul contained twenty-eight teeth.
facts.quote: Los de la mandíbula inferior tienen veintiocho dientes

facts.statement: The base of the third pair of tail osteoderms in Zuul shows a layered structure similar to the horn bases of bovids.
facts.quote: En el osteodermo izquierdo del tercer par, se ve una estructura en capas en su base, que se asemeja a la construcción de las bases de los cuernos en los bóvidos

facts.statement: The holotype was discovered when a truck carrying a twelve-meter-high load accidentally struck a tail club of an ankylosaur.
facts.quote: El 16 de mayo, un vehículo de carga al remover una sobrecarga de doce metros de alto golpeó de forma inesperada una maza caudal de un anquilosáurido.

facts.statement: The specimen was found in 2014 near Havre, Montana, while a company excavated a potential Gorgosaurus specimen.
facts.quote: En 2014, la compañía Theropoda Expeditions LLC estaba excavando un posible espécimen de Gorgosaurus cerca de Havre (Montana).

facts.statement: The skeleton was found lying on its back in a rotated position.
facts.quote: Se halló en una posición girada, con el vientre hacia arriba.

facts.statement: The largest block containing the specimen weighed fifteen tons.
facts.quote: El mayor llegaba a pesar quince toneladas.

facts.statement: The specimen was acquired by the Royal Ontario Museum in Canada in June 2016.
facts.quote: En junio de 2016, fue adquirido por el Real Museo de Ontario en Canadá.

facts.statement: The holotype ROM 75860 was found in sandstone from the Coal Ridge Member of the Judith River Formation, dated between 76.2 and 75.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: El holotipo, ROM 75860, fue hallado en una capa de arenisca de la Formación Río Judith, parte de la zona media del Miembro Coal Ridge con una edad entre 76.2 a 75.2 millones de años.

facts.statement: The expedition reported the skeleton to be 99% complete.
facts.quote: De acuerdo con Theropoda Expeditions, está completo en un 99%.

facts.statement: Remains of keratin sheaths on the spines and a dark film of scale keratin were preserved on the specimen.
facts.quote: Adicionalmente, hay restos de cubiertas de queratina de las espinas y de la queratina de escamas en la forma de una película de color oscuro.

facts.statement: The specimen was initially identified as a new species of Euoplocephalus before being named Zuul.
facts.quote: Fue identificado inicialmente como una nueva especie de Euoplocephalus.

facts.statement: The genus name Zuul was adopted from the demon and demigod Zuul, the guardian of Gozer's door in the 1984 movie Ghostbusters, whose head resembled that of an ankylosaur.
facts.quote: El nombre del género fue adoptado del demonio y semidiós Zuul, el guardián de la puerta de Gozer, representado en la película de 1984 Los cazafantasmas, cuya cabeza tenía cierto parecido a la de un anquilosáurido.

facts.statement: The species name crurivastator is derived from the Latin words crus (tibia) and vastator (destroyer).
facts.quote: El nombre de la especie se deriva del latín crus, "tibia", y vastator, "destructor".

facts.statement: The species Zuul crurivastator was named and described in 2017 by Victoria Megan Arbour and David Christopher Evans.
facts.quote: En 2017, la especie tipo Zuul crurivastator fue nombrada y descrita por Victoria Megan Arbour y David Christopher Evans.

facts.statement: Specifically, the authors identified Zuul as an Ankylosaurini within the subfamily Ankylosaurinae, forming a clade with Ankylosaurus, Anodontosaurus, Dyoplosaurus, and Scolosaurus.
facts.quote: Más específicamente, lo identificaron como un Ankylosauridae Ankylosaurinae Ankylosaurini, formando un clado con Ankylosaurus, Anodontosaurus, Dyoplosaurus y Scolosaurus.

facts.statement: In nine of the ten most parsimonious trees recovered, Zuul is the sister group to Dyoplosaurus, while in the remaining tree it is closer to Anodontosaurus.
facts.quote: De los diez árboles más parsimoniosos que recuperaron, nueve de ellos tienen a Zuul como el grupo hermano de Dyoplosaurus, mientras que en el árbol restante, Zuul está más cerca de Anodontosaurus.

facts.statement: The genus Zuul lived during the Campanian stage, between 83.6 and 72.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Campanian to Campanian (83.6 to 72.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: The parent group of Zuul is the subfamily Ankylosaurinae.
facts.quote: Parent group: Ankylosaurinae

facts.statement: Zuul belongs to the family Ankylosauridae.
facts.quote: Family: Ankylosauridae

facts.statement: Zuul is classified in the class Ornithischia.
facts.quote: Class: Ornithischia
